name: GymMatrix
install: npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && npm run build --workspace=frontend && rm -rf backend/.wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local --workspace=backend && npm run db:seed:local --workspace=backend

terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Cloudflare Worker (Hono) dev server on http://localhost:8787 — serves the /api routes against the local D1 database and the built frontend assets.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173 with HMR. Proxies /api to the backend worker on :8787. Open this URL to use the app.
